The '''Koornacht Cluster''', also known as the '''Great Multitude of the Circle of the Heavens''', '''God's Temple,''' and '''Little Nursery''', was an immense luminous disk of blazing [[Star/Legends|stars]] and [[Nebula/Legends|interstellar gas]] located in the [[Farlax sector/Legends|Farlax sector]] of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. 

==Description==
The Koornacht Cluster was an array of approximately 2,000 [[Star system/Legends|star systems]]<ref name="CatCW">''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''</ref> of [[The Negs]] region of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]],<ref name="TEA" /> on the frontier of the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]],<ref name="CatCW" /> which was named after [[Aitro Koornacht]], a palace guard on [[Tamban]] who befriended the astronomer that first discovered it. Despite this high concentration of star systems with around 20,000 worlds, only a hundred or so planets bore life and only six produced sentient lifeforms. It was believed that seventeen planets outside the [[Duskhan League]] had lifeforms of some kind, but it was difficult to survey or contact them.<ref name="BTS">''[[Before the Storm]]''</ref>

The [[Widek Bypass]] detoured around the cluster and the [[Metellos Trade Route/Legends|Metellos Trade Route]] terminated at it.

The Koornacht Cluster was known by the [[Fian/Legends|Fia]] as "The Great Multitude of the Circle of the Heavens" or simply "The Multitude", by the [[Wehttam]] as "God's Temple", by the [[Ka'aa]] as "No'aat Padu'll" or "The Little Nursery", by the Yevetha as "Home", and a number of other names.<ref name="BTS" />

==History==
[[The Crucible]] had operations in the Koornacht Cluster through the [[Sungrazer cooperative]] which operated in [[3964 BBY]]. The [[Gladiator (Crucible)|''Gladiator'']] was one such vessel that operated in the region and was involved in a fight against [[Zayne Carrick]].

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] once traveled through the Cluster where he once encountered a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] using a [[Lightwhip/Legends|lightwhip]].<ref name="The Cestus Deception">''[[The Cestus Deception]]''</ref> At some point, the [[Yevetha]] began expanding from their spawnworld of [[N'zoth]] by using [[Aramadia-class thrustship|''Aramadia''-class thrustships]] with sublight capabilities, and used them to settle [[The Twelve|eleven worlds]] in the Koornacht Cluster.

Following the end of the conflict, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] established a presence in the region where they placed the core of their [[Sixth Negative Regions|Black Sword Command]] in the Cluster with the directive of protecting the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core]] from attack. However, following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], their base of operations around [[N'zoth]] was [[Yevethan Uprising|overrun]] by the Yevetha slave forces who managed to usurp the yards from the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]]. Through the technology they had acquired, the Yevetha formed the [[Duskhan League]] and later were involved in the [[Black Fleet Crisis]] when they attempted to bring about their [[Yevethan Purge|Great Purge]] of the region.<ref name="BTS" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[Jason Fry]], co-author of ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', indicated in [[June]] [[2015]] that the Koornacht Cluster was excluded from [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|''The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion]] because it was a geographic feature bigger than a [[Sector/Legends|sector]].<ref name="Email">{{EmailCite|email=File:EAOC discussion.jpg|creator=Jason Fry|date=2015-06-30}}</ref>
